block.description: Manages the organisation-wide default MDM server assignment for each Apple device family in Apple Business Manager. Requires business API scope. This is a singleton resource; only one instance should exist per provider configuration. On first apply, set each attribute to match the current ABM assignment so Terraform can track the state before making changes. Moving a family between servers (e.g. ipad from server A to server B) requires that the prior assignment be tracked in state; if a family is assigned to an untracked server, Apple will return a 409 conflict when the provider tries to claim it.
